title: First Corinthians 15 in the RSV states that Christ was raised on the third day
summary: The RSV of 1 Corinthians 15 says Christ was raised on the third day.
body: The Revised Standard Version of 1 Corinthians 15 says Christ died for sins, was buried, and was raised on the third day, and then lists appearances. Paul presents this as what he received. The card does not decide the historical debate outside the letter. The wording on the page includes: "Christ died for our sins in accordance with the scriptures, 4 that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day in accordance with the scriptures, 5 and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve. 6 Then he appeared to more than five hundred brethren at one time, most of whom are still alive, though some have fallen asleep. 7 Then he appeared to". The evidence label is the truth-gate ceiling for this host. The host is not on the gate's primary-text or official list, so the label is weak. The quotation is still the page's wording.
